policy area to permit a multiple dwelling with a floor space ratio of 1.33 whereas the
designation currently permits an FSR of 0.75. The land use designation would be retained.

would change the zoning to Res. 5. The ZBA would also add a site-specific provision. The requested

regulate the minimum and maximum front yard setbacks. It would regulate the minimum exterior
side yard setback, the minimum interior side yard setback, the floor space ratio. It would not
require private patio areas on ground floor units. It would allow the number of parking spaces to be
five and the number of visitor parking spaces to be three. It would allow a maximum of two compact
parking spaces while prohibiting geothermal energy systems.
